Strong project management experience.
Critical thinking and ability to understand business needs and connect them to technical roadmaps and solutions.
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Information Technology, or a related field.

Work with stakeholders to design and use Marketo Custom Objects to store and manage unique business data, using them to enrich segments, smart lists, and campaigns.

Support data hygiene, list development, prospect segmentation, form management, and data model governance. Collaborate on building and testing responsive email templates that meet quality standards and email best practices.

cond_0091.intro: We are looking for a Digital Marketing Analyst to join our team.
cond_0091.responsibilities: Planning and building nurture streams, managing one-off emails, and building/maintaining landing pages for events, webinars, email sequences, etc. Form creation management, field mapping, and work with team to sync with Salesforce CRM systems – form creation and management includes integrations with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Deploy and maintain Marketo Munchkin code on websites to track visitor behavior and facilitate lead generation and scoring mechanisms. Design and use Marketo Custom Objects to store and manipulate unique business data, using them to enrich segments, smart lists, and campaigns. Configure and execute Smart Campaigns in Marketo, leveraging their dynamic capabilities for targeted and responsive marketing efforts. Utilize Marketo Flow Actions to automate complex marketing processes, enhancing campaign execution and operational efficiency. Support the generation and implementation of test strategies, including A/B testing to drive qualified traffic and revenue-building activities improvements that could potentially increase conversions. Monitor, analyze, and report on the performance of programs. Mapping and creation of automation to support multi-channel attribution. Developing and monitoring of lead grading and scoring model strategies to ensure optimization of lead funnel. Data hygiene, list development/prospect segmentation, reform management, and data model governance. Build and test responsive email templates that meet quality standards and email best practices. Execution of marketing best practices, including configuration and maintenance of campaign and nurture workflows, program builds, and associated reporting metrics. Assist with technical feasibility, implementation approach, deployment strategies, and QA effort.
cond_0091.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3–5 Years of hands-on Marketo experience
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Information Technology, or related field
Strong collaboration and project management experience
Critical thinking and ability to understand business needs and connect them to technical roadmaps and solutions
Ability to articulate complex data integration requirements and present recommendations clearly
Aptitude for technical challenges as well as business acumen
Preferred Requirements
Marketo data migration from legacy systems experience
Salesforce CRM experience
Adobe CDP experience
Solutions-oriented mindset that enables collaboration across multiple teams
Self-starter with ability to work independently and within a team

Working alongside the team, you will plan and build nurture streams, manage one-off emails, and help build and maintain landing pages for events, webinars, email sequences, and more. You will coordinate on form creation and field mapping, and work with the team to sync with Salesforce CRM systems — including integrations with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
Collaborate with web teams to deploy and maintain Marketo Munchkin code on websites to track visitor behavior and support lead generation and scoring mechanisms. Work with stakeholders to design and use Marketo Custom Objects to store and manage unique business data, using them to enrich segments, smart lists, and campaigns.
Coordinate the configuration and execution of Smart Campaigns in Marketo, leveraging their dynamic capabilities for targeted and responsive marketing efforts. Work with the team to apply Marketo Flow Actions to automate complex marketing processes, supporting campaign execution and operational efficiency.
Help develop and implement test strategies, including A/B testing, to support qualified traffic and conversion improvements. Monitor, analyze, and share reports on program performance with relevant stakeholders. Coordinate mapping and creation of automation to support multi-channel attribution.
Work alongside the team to develop and monitor lead grading and scoring model strategies to keep the lead funnel optimized. Support data hygiene, list development, prospect segmentation, form management, and data model governance. Collaborate on building and testing responsive email templates that meet quality standards and email best practices.
Help ensure execution of marketing best practices, including configuration and maintenance of campaign and nurture workflows, program builds, and associated reporting metrics. Assist the team with technical feasibility, implementation approach, deployment strategies, and QA effort.
cond_0477.requirements:
Minimum Requirements**
3–5 Years of hands-on Marketo experience
Strong collaboration and project management experience
Critical thinking and ability to understand business needs and connect them to technical roadmaps and solutions
Ability to articulate complex data integration requirements and present recommendations clearly so the team understands next steps and goals
Aptitude for technical challenges as well as business acumen
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Information Technology, or related field
Preferred Requirements**
Marketo data migration from legacy systems experience
Salesforce CRM experience
Adobe CDP experience
Solutions-oriented mindset that enables collaboration across multiple teams
Ability to work independently as well as within a team
